command: set -euo pipefail; python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v; for file in build/*.sh overlay/usr/bin/*; do if head -n 1 "$file" | rg -q "bash|/sh"; then bash -n "$file"; fi; done; python3 build/verify-deb-files.py --package "$(python3 build/package-info.py path)" --version "$(python3 build/package-info.py version)" --manifest image/installer/installed-files.txt --report "$OREZ_EVIDENCE_DIR/package-audit.json"; git diff --check

interpretation.Scope: First PC release; Android emulation deferred, web YouTube explicitly authorized. No new full ISO or installation release.
interpretation.Authentication: Five real isolated PAM/sudo/account scenarios passed; live-boot predicate substituted in test fixture only. Full boot, SDDM authentication and Polkit dialogs NOT verified.
interpretation.Greeter: Actual SDDM test-mode rendering. 06/15 have a blank session control; final 18 correctly discloses no desktop session and disables login. Host lacks render device; no fake device or graphics qualification.
interpretation.Daily apps: Final 17 passes eight native Calendar/Reuz interactions, including actual Qt palette changes. 13/16 retain failed palette attempts. No cloud calendar, background/wake alarm or Android runtime.
interpretation.Reports: Report PNGs are captured test output, not pictures of a running OS. Xvfb native windows are component evidence, not ISO/hardware evidence.
interpretation.Failures: All nine failed attempts are retained: 01, 02, 05, 08, 11, 13, 14, 16, 19. Read source docs/FIRST_PC_RELEASE.md for causes and corrected checks.
interpretation.Upgrade: Final 21 tests actual offline 0.1.0-3 to 0.1.0-4 component upgrade; user data preserved and non-admin installation denied. Signed production updates remain incomplete.
